CMCS.description: Camber for Construction Stage (CMCS). Keyed by element number; each entry stores the deformation-based and user-defined camber values for that element.

DEFORM.description: Camber value derived from the construction-stage deformation of the element (T_CMCS_D.dDeform). Length unit per active unit system.

USER.description: User-defined camber value for the element (T_CMCS_D.dUser). Length unit per active unit system.
